notes.title: UPDATE 1.3
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've been working to fix most of the bugs encountered by you and have addressed most of the issues in this update. When I'm happy that bugs have been fixed I can then concentrate on adding any additional content for the game. Update notes below.

[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
- Tooltips for unit buttons
- 2 new ambient audio tracks

[h1]CHANGES:[/h1]
- Graphical settings no longer on very lowest when playing for the first time
- Removed original ambient audio track which had some rather obnoxious birds
- Increased starting food resources, allowing you to create warriors straight away to help defend your capital
- If a unit needs orders when clicking the next turn button, it now selects that unit for you as well as taking you to its position

[h1]FIXES:[/h1]
- Fixed research panel not opening in tutorial level 3 which prevented progress
- Fixed enemy city and warrior not spawning in tutorial level 4
- Fixed UI issues in tutorial levels
- Fixed researching an upgrade in one level no longer effecting other levels (Example, if you researched a farm upgrade in the tutorial, it would be available in a standard game).
- Stopped you being able to create multiple units on the capital city hex, which wouldn't allow you to select the units
- Fixed Unit Under Attack button not moving camera to battle after loading existing game
- Prevented unit from getting stuck if any move buttons are pressed while constructing a building
- Fixed the AI units breaking during battle after loading an existing game due to not referencing the hex the player unit is on
- Fixed error when loading in save slot 6
- Fixed error where a worker currently constructing would break when loading an existing game

[h1]COMING SHORTLY:[/h1]
- Windowed mode
- Improved AI


Thank you,
Matthew
Red Phoenix Studios

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2
notes.content:
Hi,

This update includes numerous fixes and changes to the game, including some quality of life and performance improvements.

[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
- New LODs for building models

[h1]FIXES:[/h1]
- Fires not extinguishing after a building was destroyed
- Town health not displaying correctly when taking damage
- Blur setting now working correctly

[h1]CHANGES:[/h1]
- Changed "Challenges" to "Tutorial", making it clear what it is
- Decreased chance of building fires
- Buildings now correctly remove resource income if destroyed
- Increased enemy warrior production rate
- You can now cancel research by simply selecting another one

[h1]PLANNED:[/h1]
Here are a couple of things I have planned for next update(s):
- Improved AI
- Improved Help menu

[h1]POSSIBLE IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1]
- Map creator
- More natural disasters

Thanks,
Matthew
Red Phoenix Studios

notes.content:
Hi all,

This is just a quick fix update, but more fixes and general improvements are on the way!

I was made aware of a critical bug that caused you to not be able to progress when skipping a turn. This has now been fixed.

Best Regards.
Matthew
Red Phoenix Studios
